elitecelebs_: Otto Elitecelebs found a place in S-F14 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.
Otto Elitecelebs was in the first hundred. The old hands in S-F14 call them 'the early birds', and not always kindly.

A bullet went through Otto Elitecelebs's sleeve at S-F14 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. The Concord took Verdel Ridge. Otto Elitecelebs watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
The medics cleaned Otto Elitecelebs's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at S-F14.
galvanooooo: Emil Galvanooooo reported to S-F11 with a pocket Bible with a hole in it sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
Emil Galvanooooo is one of the first hundred to answer the call. He wears the ribbon of the First Wave.
Emil Galvanooooo began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else.

Word of Emil Galvanooooo's blanket spread. A strip of lining and a square from an old scarf arrived without explanation. Verdel Ridge fell to the Concord. Emil Galvanooooo kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
A football came over the parapet from the Concord side with Bram "Hollow" Localfilipin's name scratched on it. Emil Galvanooooo kicked it back. It did not come again.
